newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 100 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 100 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 100 billion dong ($8.57 million) of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.5 percent to domestic and foreign institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on June 18, the central bank issued 100 billion dong of one-year notes at a rate of 11.95 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is June 27 and maturity will be on June 27, 1998.
